name: На рекорд: підсумок
description:
Hello future chess grandmasters! Here we are, at the grand finale of our forcing moves adventure! We've come a long way, discovered all kinds of fascinating techniques - forcing moves, sacrifices, attacking pieces and squares, and even clearing lines and squares. You have mastered all these tricks and I am super proud of you!

In this last lesson, we mix it all up. All the types of forcing moves you've learned will be used interchangeably again in different tasks. And to make it even more exciting, we added some extra difficult challenges. What a chess party!

It may be challenging, but don't forget how far you have already come. You have proven that you are not only strong a attacker, but also a smart thinker. And you know what? When you complete this lesson, you will be a real chess champion!

Let's get to work on this final lesson and let's see what you can do.
